SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Auto-detect DPI
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Use this phone's own screen density for the AA session

Preference.android:title: Car profiles
Preference.android:summary: Save/load video and AA settings per car (screen shape, resolution, fill mode, etc.)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Skip the CarAALink home screen and start the AA session as soon as the head unit server is up

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Force 720p
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Use 720p even when Auto would choose 1080p. Auto already selects 720p for the 1920×720 screen; Custom resolution takes precedence.

ListPreference.android:summary: AA has no resolution matching this car's screen shape, so one of these is unavoidable

ListPreference.android:title: Mic / speaker for Android Auto
ListPreference.android:summary: Which device handles AA voice/media audio in and out

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Auto-crop to car screen shape
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Computes the AA video crop automatically from this car's real screen size, instead of a plain letterbox. Turn off if the picture looks worse than Fit/Fill alone.

Preference.android:title: Car home background
Preference.android:summary: Pick a photo for the car home screen

Preference.android:title: Now playing on car home
Preference.android:summary: Grant notification access so the car home screen can show what's playing

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Auto-start head unit server
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: When tapping the Android Auto tile and it isn't running yet, automatically open AA's Settings and flip its developer toggle via the accessibility service. Turn off to just get a notification and start it yourself instead.
Reconnect automatically if the USB link drops

ListPreference.android:title: USB role override (debug)
ListPreference.android:summary: Confirmed: phone is the USB accessory, head unit is the host. Only override for testing.

ListPreference.android:title: Update channel
ListPreference.android:summary: Stable checks GitHub's tagged Releases; Dev checks the rolling 'dev' pre-release CI rebuilds on every push to main -- opens the release page either way, nothing installs itself

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Check automatically
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Check once per app launch; only notifies when something newer actually exists

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Protocol sniffer
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Log every CarbitLink/Android Auto control message with a hex preview, including video/audio frames (noisy -- exported from Developer tools)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: On-screen debug overlay
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Show fps/bitrate/drops over the mirror, AA session, and this app's own screen

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Auto-save crash log to Downloads
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: On a crash, save the current log straight to Downloads automatically -- no need to dig through Developer tools afterward

Preference.android:title: Accessibility service
Preference.android:summary: Required for one-click head-unit-server start — tap to open system settings
